changelog: **Security — `GET /api/cron` no longer lets one tenant's admin run another tenant's or a platform-wide job (#1575):** `job=trial-reminders&orgId=` took the org from the query with only an ADMIN check, so any tenant ADMIN could drive another tenant's trial sweep (its mails, bells and `TRIAL_ACTIVE → TRIAL_EXPIRED` moves) and read its counts. `orgId` is now honoured only for the caller's own org or one `isSuperAdminFor()` reaches (super admin is per world, #2647). The batch, every platform-wide named job (usage-rollup, audit-drain, newsletters, dormant, retention, dlq-alert, …) and any unknown job name, which falls through to the batch, now take `isSuperAdmin()`. The own-org jobs (relation-health, evaluations, program-journey, surveys, report-subscriptions) are unchanged. A refusal answers 403 and writes an `authz.scope_denied` audit row. The retention prune, unreachable because it shared the name `retention` with the reminders branch, is now `job=retention-prune`. `e2e/cron-tenant-scope.spec.ts` (@smoke) pins the refusals; the specs that drive platform-wide jobs now sign in as a super admin, and the trial-reminders specs as the tenant's own admin on its own host.
